foot_line: Custom AI systems, designed around the way you work.

Designs, builds and tests each app, then prepares it for the App Store

ideas.what: Owner and tenant email sorted as it arrives, with the right lease or rule attached and a reply drafted.
Bids, permits, invoices and inspections for every job in one place, and a morning list of what's due.
Vendors, guest lists and timelines for every event, with reminders that go out on time.
Showings, offers and closing dates tracked for every client, with updates written for you.
Orders, reviews and stock checked overnight, with a short list of what needs you today.
School email, bills, appointments and warranties in one place you can simply ask.

faq: Whatever your work already runs on: email, texts, calendars, shared folders, spreadsheets, websites and many online services.
Does it have to be an app?
No. It can be a message on your phone each morning, a website, a private dashboard, an iPhone app, or a mix of them.
How much does it do on its own?
As much or as little as you like. Some people want drafts to approve; others want jobs handled start to finish. You choose, and you can change it later.
We agree on that up front and set it up the way you're comfortable with.
It depends on what the system does. Tell us the idea and we'll come back with a plan and a price.
It keeps working for you, and we can keep extending it as your needs change.

qa.title: AI-built. Not AI slop.
qa.lede: Software thrown together with AI has earned a reputation for looking fine and falling apart. Ours goes through strict testing and review before it reaches you, because the experience is the product.
points: Nothing counts as done until it has been run and checked on screen. Passing tests alone don't prove it works.
Reviewers from three different AI companies judge the experience the way a newcomer would: is it clear at a glance, and would you show it to a friend? It doesn't ship without a pass.
Automated tests run against real databases, real browsers and simulated iPhones, and they have to pass before anything ships.
The code is reviewed line by line, the way a careful colleague would, before anything goes out.
When something misses its target, nobody moves the goalposts or calls it close enough. It gets fixed.
Known issues get fixed, not shipped
Anything spotted before launch is fixed first, even small cosmetic things.

steps: A sentence is enough: the thing you keep losing track of, the job that eats your evenings, the question you wish you could just ask.
We map how the work happens
Where information arrives, what decisions you make, who else is involved and what a great result looks like to you.
What it does on its own, what it checks with you first and how it reaches you. It's your system, set up your way.
We build it and switch it on
You see it working on your real day-to-day, then it grows one piece at a time as your needs do.
